svg.data-weight-note: 9.59 kg (21.14 lb), with two installed PSUs
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: quick start: DAC cables or QSFP28 transceivers; "1 LED Green - 100 Gbps mode, 1 LED Blue - 40 Gbps mode", with 25 Gbps and 10 Gbps four-lane breakout modes.
svg.data-emissions: EN 55032 Class A, EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, AS/NZS Class A, ICES-003 Class A, FCC Class A, VCCI Class A, BSMI Class A, KC Class A (AC SKU only)
